Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Apply explicit corrections to the final stated intent. Preserve meaningful filler-like words and unfinished thoughts. Apply clearly spoken punctuation and list cues. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i was checking the screen reader audit notes for the east entrance at the library on thursday afternoon the test covered the booking page the confirmation message and the printed cost summary i read each section with the screen reader and compared what it announced with the visible text the correct total for the audit visit was 161.98 not 46.71 the lower amount belonged to an earlier estimate and it was not the amount charged i checked the receipt again because the first announcement stopped just before the cents the screen reader said one hundred sixty one dollars and ninety eight cents when i moved back to the total line the written summary also showed 161.98 i noted that the result was consistent across the receipt and the page the audit log records the browser version and the speech setting that i used it also records that i tested the page with the keyboard only i left the original estimate in the notes so the reviewer can distinguish it from the final charge the staff member who booked the visit asked me to send the corrected audit entry before the weekly review", "output": "I was checking the screen reader audit notes for the east entrance at the library on Thursday afternoon. The test covered the booking page, the confirmation message, and the printed cost summary. I read each section with the screen reader and compared what it announced with the visible text. The correct total for the audit visit was 161.98, not 46.71. The lower amount belonged to an earlier estimate, and it was not the amount charged. I checked the receipt again because the first announcement stopped just before the cents. The screen reader said one hundred sixty-one dollars and ninety-eight cents when I moved back to the total line. The written summary also showed 161.98. I noted that the result was consistent across the receipt and the page. The audit log records the browser version and the speech setting that I used. It also records that I tested the page with the keyboard only. I left the original estimate in the notes so the reviewer can distinguish it from the final charge. The staff member who booked the visit asked me to send the corrected audit entry before the weekly review."}]
